veranderings.blok: Hoe siektes oorgaan en hoe hulle wys
veranderings.rede: Movement into the air takes the postposition: 'die lug in', not 'in die lug'.

veranderings.blok: Hoe siektes oorgaan en hoe hulle wys
veranderings.na: Die siek mens ervaar hulle self.
veranderings.rede: 'Die mens' has no antecedent in this block; 'die siek mens' matches the next sentence and the earlier 'n siek mens'.

veranderings.voor: hoofpyn en is kou of sluk pynlik
veranderings.na: hoofpyn, en is dit pynlik om te kou of te sluk
veranderings.rede: 'is kou of sluk pynlik' is wooden; a clause with its own subject reads naturally and takes the AWS comma before 'en'.

veranderings.voor: Die mens kan ook koors hê
veranderings.na: Iemand met TB kan ook koors hê
veranderings.rede: 'Die mens' has no clear antecedent; the block speaks of 'iemand met TB'.

veranderings.voor: Jy kan nies en 'n loopneus of toe neus, keelseer en hoes kry.
veranderings.na: Jy kan nies en ook 'n loopneus of toe neus, keelseer en 'n hoes kry.
veranderings.rede: The verb 'nies' reads as the first item of the noun list; 'ook' separates the two verb phrases and ''n hoes' makes 'hoes' clearly a noun.
In a relative clause the verb goes last.

veranderings.voor: Droog jou voete goed af tussen die tone
veranderings.na: Droog jou voete goed tussen die tone af
veranderings.rede: The separable particle 'af' belongs at the end of the clause, after the place phrase.
A disease does not 'become healthy'; the protected wording is 'TB kan gesond gemaak word'.

veranderings.na: gee die beste kans om gesond te word.
veranderings.rede: 'die beste kans' is left hanging (a chance of what?); the protected wording completes it with 'om gesond te word'.

veranderings.na: dadelik as dit moeilik word om asem te haal
veranderings.rede: 'asemhaal' as a bare subject is stiff; 'as dit moeilik word om asem te haal' is the natural phrase.

veranderings.voor: Vra 'n verpleegster of dokter of by jou skool.
veranderings.na: Vra 'n verpleegster, 'n dokter of iemand by jou skool.
veranderings.rede: The two 'of's join unlike parts (people and a place phrase); a parallel list of three people reads cleanly.

veranderings.voor: wat mense sê of aanlyn staan
veranderings.na: wat mense sê of wat aanlyn staan
veranderings.rede: 'wat' is object in the first clause and subject in the second, so it must be repeated.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Strictly a person is made healthy, not a disease; 'TB kan genees word' would be the idiomatic form, but it is listed under NIE, so the protected form is proposed as is.
